localEquivalentBeforeStaging.providerRegistry: open-sse/providers/registry/novita.js: apikey, default Bearer, chat transport https://api.novita.ai/openai/v1/chat/completions, validateUrl /openai/v1/models, no serviceKinds/hiddenKinds, four chat models
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.videoGenerationAdapter: none (getVideoGenerationAdapter('novita') is null; VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS has alibaba, ali, renderhour, adobe-firefly-api, adobe-firefly-web)

exports.createNovitaVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildNovitaVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { prompt, negative_prompt?, duration?, width?, height? }; throws status 400
exports.resolveNovitaTiming: (body) -> { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs } from timeout_ms / poll_interval_ms with source ceilings; throws status 400
exports.runNovitaVideoTask: submit + bounded poll; { success, url, taskId, accounting } or error result with acceptedJob
